description: Map HNF4alpha fatty-acid contact residues onto NHR-47 and plot cavity/pLDDT summary
code:
import numpy as np, requests, json
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'}
exec_globals=None
def parse_pdb(txt,hetatm=False,model1=True):
    atoms=[]
    for ln in txt.split('\n'):
        if model1 and ln.startswith('ENDMDL'): break
        rec=ln[:6]
        if rec=='ATOM  ' or (hetatm and rec=='HETATM'):
            if ln[16] not in (' ','A'): continue
            try: atoms.append(dict(rec=rec.strip(),name=ln[12:16].strip(),resn=ln[17:20].strip(),chain=ln[21],
                resi=int(ln[22:26]),x=float(ln[30:38]),y=float(ln[38:46]),z=float(ln[46:54]),
                b=float(ln[60:66] or 0),elem=(ln[76:78].strip() or ln[12:16].strip()[0]).upper()))
            except ValueError: pass
    return atoms
AA3='ALA ARG ASN ASP CYS GLN GLU GLY HIS ILE LEU LYS MET PHE PRO SER THR TRP TYR VAL'.split()
t31=dict(zip(AA3,'ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYV'))

# ---- which HNF4alpha residues actually touch the fatty acid, and what is at the NHR-47 equivalent? ----
pzl=parse_pdb(requests.get('https://files.rcsb.org/download/1PZL.pdb',headers=H,timeout=90).text,hetatm=True)
prot=[a for a in pzl if a['rec']=='ATOM' and a['chain']=='A' and a['elem'] in ('C','N','O','S')]
myr=[a for a in pzl if a['rec']=='HETATM' and a['resn']=='MYR' and a['chain']=='A']
L=np.array([[a['x'],a['y'],a['z']] for a in myr]); X=np.array([[a['x'],a['y'],a['z']] for a in prot])
tr=cKDTree(X); contact={}
for js in tr.query_ball_point(L,4.5):
    for j in js: contact.setdefault(prot[j]['resi'],prot[j]['resn'])
contact=dict(sorted(contact.items()))
print(f"HNF4alpha (1PZL) residues within 4.5 A of myristate: {len(contact)}")
print(' '.join(f"{v}{k}" for k,v in contact.items()))
# region split
ins_region=[k for k in contact if 222<=k<=258]
print(f"\nOf these, {len(ins_region)}/{len(contact)} lie in HNF4A 222-258 (H6 / S1-S2 beta-hairpin / H7), the segment "
      f"replaced in NHR-47 by the 258-435 insertion: {' '.join(f'{contact[k]}{k}' for k in ins_region)}")

# ---- summary figure ----
labels=['HNF4g LBD\n1LV2 +palmitate','HNF4a LBD\n1PZL +myristate','NHR-49 LBD\n(AlphaFold)',
        'NHR-47 LBD core\n(AlphaFold)','Nurr1 LBD\n1OVL (no pocket)']
vols=[472,162,334,80,80]
kd=[0.82,1.50,0.37,-0.87,-0.39]
fh=[0.57,0.63,0.52,0.36,0.36]
cols=['#2a6f97','#2a6f97','#5fa8d3','#c1121f','#8d99ae']
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(13,4.2))
for a,(vals,ttl,yl) in zip(ax,[(vols,'Largest enclosed cavity','Volume (cubic Angstrom)'),
                               (kd,'Cavity lining hydrophobicity','Mean Kyte-Doolittle of lining residues'),
                               (fh,'Apolar lining residues','Fraction A/V/L/I/M/F/W/C')]):
    a.bar(range(5),vals,color=cols)
    a.set_xticks(range(5)); a.set_xticklabels(labels,fontsize=7.5,rotation=30,ha='right')
    a.set_title(ttl,fontsize=10); a.set_ylabel(yl,fontsize=8.5)
    a.axhline(0,color='k',lw=0.6)
    for i,v in enumerate(vals): a.text(i,v+(0.02*max(map(abs,vals)))*np.sign(v if v else 1),f"{v:g}",ha='center',fontsize=8)
fig.suptitle('NHR-47 ligand-binding pocket prediction: LIGSITE-style cavity detection (0.8 A grid, 1.4 A probe, PSP>=9)',fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

# ---- pLDDT / architecture figure ----
m=requests.get('https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/Q17370',headers=H,timeout=90).json()[0]
at47=parse_pdb(requests.get(m['pdbUrl'],headers=H,timeout=90).text)
ca=[a for a in at47 if a['name']=='CA']
r=np.array([a['resi'] for a in ca]); p=np.array([a['b'] for a in ca])
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(12,3.4))
ax.fill_between(r,0,p,color='#8ecae6'); ax.plot(r,p,color='#023047',lw=0.8)
for lo,hi,c,lab in [(10,80,'#90be6d','DBD'),(141,255,'#f4a261','LBD N-half\n(H1-H5)'),
                    (258,435,'#e63946','180-residue insertion\n(replaces HNF4a H6/S1-S2/H7)'),
                    (440,550,'#f4a261','LBD C-half\n(H8-H12)')]:
    ax.axvspan(lo,hi,color=c,alpha=0.25); ax.text((lo+hi)/2,104,lab,ha='center',fontsize=8)
ax.axhline(70,ls='--',color='grey',lw=0.8); ax.text(565,72,'pLDDT 70',fontsize=7,color='grey')
ax.set_xlabel('NHR-47 residue (UniProt Q17370)'); ax.set_ylabel('pLDDT'); ax.set_ylim(0,118); ax.set_xlim(1,579)
ax.set_title('AlphaFold confidence along NHR-47: the HNF4 pocket-forming segment is a disordered insertion',fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
